requirement.summary: [Bug Fix] Error in extra language settings when exporting Recipes
requirement.description:
Current behaviour

An error occurred in the extra language setting of the form after exporting Recipes at the sub config zone.

Setup

| spa

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Period Set Lookup overlap check ignores seconds
requirement.description:
Use Case:

Period Set Lookup does not allow overlapped periods when Allow Overlapped Period is disabled. Periods that do not share any second should still be saved. Example: Breakfast ends at 12:00:00 and Lunch starts at 12:00:01.

Steps to Reproduce:

1. In TMS system config, set Allow Overlapped Period to disabled.

2. On an outlet, prepare two periods:

- Breakfast: 06:00:00 - 12:00:00

- Lunch: 12:00:01 - 17:00:00

3. Open a Period Set that already includes Breakfast.

4. Add Lunch to the same Period Set and click Save.

Current Result:

Save is blocked by the alert "Overlapped Period is Not Allowed".

Selected Period: Lunch (12:00:01 - 17:00:00)

Overlapped Periods: Breakfast (06:00 - 12:00)

The save check drops the seconds and compares HH:mm as a closed interval, so 12:00:01 and 12:00:00 both become 12:00 and are treated as overlapping.

Expected Result:

Lunch starting at 12:00:01 does not overlap Breakfast ending at 12:00:00, and Save succeeds.

Periods that touch on the same second (for example both 12:00:00) are still treated as overlapping.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-69248] Period set overlap check includes seconds
Descriptions:
• When Allow Overlapped Period is set to No, a period that starts one second after another period ends can be saved in the same period set. For example, Breakfast ending at 12:00:00 and Lunch starting at 12:00:01 are no longer treated as overlapped.
• Two periods that meet on the same second, such as one ending at 12:00:00 and the next starting at 12:00:00, are still not allowed.
Setup:
Go to Admin→ Table Management System→ System Configuration and set Allow Overlapped Period to No.
Go to Admin→ Outlet→ Periods and confirm start and end times include seconds.
Go to Admin→ Table Management System→ Period Sets and open the period set. Lunch ending at 18:00:00 and Dinner starting at 18:00:01 are saved together, without the alert Overlapped Period is Not Allowed.

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Infinite Loading when mark arrival with POS return error 'Member ID mismatch. Cannot link check'
requirement.description:
Email:

TMS 2.0 Mark Arrival stays on the loading dialog when POS returns an error, instead of showing the error alert.

Use Case:

Member X990-99-01 is marked arrived on table 41 and has already sent items to the kitchen. The check will be settled by another member, X758-97-01. After the first booking is set to Completed and the original member is cleared on the POS check, Mark Arrival for X758-97-01 never leaves the loading dialog.

Steps to Reproduce:

- Member X990-99-01 books table 41 at 06:15.

- Mark Arrival for that booking and open table 41.

- Order and send the check to the kitchen.

- Create another booking for member X758-97-01 at 07:15 on table 41.

- Mark Arrival for X758-97-01 is blocked because the POS member and the TMS member are different.

- Set the X990-99-01 booking to Completed, then clear member X990-99-01 on table 41 in POS.

- Mark Arrival again for the 07:15 booking of X758-97-01 on table 41.

Current Result:

The operation screen stays on the loading dialog. The error returned by POS / the mark-arrival API is not shown. [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

When Mark Arrival gets an error back from the API, close the loading dialog and show that error alert (for example "Member ID mismatch. Cannot link check."). [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

Mark Arrival turns on the saving loader before the request. A response body that contains error was not treated as a failure, so the loader stayed up and the alert was never opened. A rejected request also left the loader up across the error alert.

Fix:

Operation UI only. In mark-arrival save, if the API response contains error, turn the loader off immediately and open the alert with that message. On a rejected request, turn the loader off before the existing error alert. No backend change. An open-check list with an empty error is unchanged.

requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Online booking auto-assigns lower-rated table when two same-size tables have different ratings
requirement.description:
Email/ ZOHO Title:

TMS - Table Rating Issue | The Clearwater Bay Golf & Country Club

Use Case:

User reported that two same-size tables were set with rating 1 and rating 2. When making an online reservation, the system auto-assigned the table with rating 1 instead of the higher-rated table.

Steps to Reproduce:

Set two same-size tables to rating 1 and 2>Enable online auto assign table for the period>Make an online reservation that fits that table size>Check assigned table

Current Result:

The booking is assigned to the table with rating 1 [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

The booking is assigned to the table with the higher rating (rating 2) [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

When several same-size tables are free, auto-assign does not keep the highest rating as the winner. It can pick the last table it checks instead, so a lower-rated table is assigned.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing : [HERO-69139] Online booking auto-assigns lower-rated table when two same-size tables have different ratings
Descriptions :
When making an online reservation, if two tables of the same size are available with different ratings, the system could assign the lower-rated table. After this fix, auto-assign chooses the table with the higher rating.
Setup :
1. Go to Outlet > Floor Plans. Open the floor plan used by the outlet, then open the Floor Plan Map table layout. Click two tables of the same size. In the Edit Table dialog, set Table Rating to 1 on one table and 2 on the other, then save.
2. Go to TMS > Period Sets. Open the period set and edit the Period. Set Auto Assign Table (Online) to Yes, then save.
3. If the test date already has operating records, go to TMS > Config by Date, open that date and period, set Auto Assign Table (Online) to Yes, then save.
4. Open the Online Reservation page. Make a booking for a guest count that fits those two tables, while both tables are free.
5. Go to TMS Operation, open the new reservation, and check Table No. It should be the table with rating 2.

requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Show detail check information in TMS Cart view - Dev (2/2)
requirement.description:
User Story:

As a TMS user with floorplan access, I want to view detailed check information in a cart view so that I can monitor table status and guest details at a glance in a tabular format, without relying on the floorplan layout.

Current Behavior:

TMS currently only supports the floorplan view. There is no cart view available to display detailed check information in a tabular format. The floorplan view already assigns colors to represent table status; these status colors are the source of truth that the new cart view must reuse.

Expected Behavior:

TMS should support a cart view similar to POS, using the same status colors as the existing floorplan view. Users can toggle between floorplan view and cart view, keeping both available. The cart view should display Table Number (with extensions), Table Name, Table Reference, First Name, Last Name, Cover, Member Number, Membership Number, Member group account, Check total, and Last order time, controlled by per-location backend configuration. Users can sort by table number, status, cover, check total, and last order time. All columns sort ascending by default, with null/empty values always placed last. The cart view auto-refreshes periodically to keep status and totals current without user action.

Acceptance Criteria:

Toggle between floorplan and cart view

> - Given a TMS user with floorplan access is on the floorplan view

> - When the user activates the cart view toggle/button

> - Then the cart view is displayed with table and check details in a tabular format

> - And the user can toggle back to the floorplan view

> - And both views remain available for the user

> - But a TMS user without floorplan access cannot see or activate the cart view toggle

Display check detail columns per location configuration

> - Given the cart view is open and the per-location backend configuration defines the visible columns

> - When tables with open checks are loaded

> - Then each row shows Table Number (with extensions), Table Name, Table Reference, First Name, Last Name, Cover, Member Number, Membership Number, Member group account, Check total, and

Last order time

> - And only the columns enabled in the per-location backend configuration are displayed

> - But if a table has no open check, the row still appears with the table number and status, and check-related fields are empty

Represent table status with floorplan colors

> - Given the cart view is open and tables are displayed

> - When a table has a given status

> - Then the table row uses the same status color as the existing TMS floorplan view for that status

Sort tables by column

> - Given the cart view is open and multiple tables are displayed

> - When the user sorts by table number

> - Then tables are sorted numerically by base table number, then alphabetically by extension (e.g., 101, 101A, 101B, 102)

> - And the user can also sort by status, cover, check total, and last order time

> - And all columns sort ascending by default

> - But if a table has no value for the selected sort column (e.g., no open check), it is placed at the end of the sort order

Auto-refresh cart view data

> - Given the cart view is open

> - When a periodic refresh interval elapses

> - Then the cart view auto-refreshes to keep table status and check totals current without user action

> - And the user's active sort order and column configuration are preserved after the refresh
